Initial public release of the building-mcp-servers skill.

- Guides creation of MCP servers in TypeScript, Python, or C#, focusing on tool design, transport layers, authentication, and evaluation setup.
- Includes structured development workflow: research, implementation, review/testing, and evaluation creation.
- Recommends best practices for naming, input/output schemas, error handling, and agent-friendly design.
- Provides clear links and guidance for relevant protocol and SDK documentation.
- Clarifies scope: for building new MCP servers only (not consuming/configuring existing ones).
